thread:
Nora (partnerships): quick heads-up — we need to sunset the legacy Authorization header `Bearer-V1` from the Partner API. Target enforcement date May 6. 6-week runway. Need partner comms, marketplace coord, and SDK adapters. http://go/redwood/sunset-v1
Sam (eng): ok, can we add a gateway compatibility toggle so we can keep accepting both for a short window? :eyes:
Maria (product): partnerships + docs comms required. I can draft partner-facing copy and portal banner. Do we want a private partner preview before public docs?
Lee (legal): check contracts — will this affect existing SLAs or data obligations? need to confirm notice period language.
Oliver (platform): runtime feasibility: we can accept both headers and emit deprecation logs for ~30 days, then reject. Recommend canary in eu-west first. We can add header `X-RW-Compat: shim` when shim used.
Priya (devex): I can own a lightweight SDK adapter that auto-translates v1 headers to v2 for customers who can't upgrade immediately. plan: open-source shim + npm/pypi packages. ETA Apr 15 for initial PR.
DevBot: @Nora created issue RNW-4821 "Sunset legacy auth header (Bearer-V1)" — https://issues.redwood.ai/RNW-4821
Sam (eng): will add telemetry events for `deprecated_auth_v1` and a dashboard for partner impact. also recommend a grace flag behind feature-gate.
Nora (partnerships): action list: Partnerships to ping top 12 partners + marketplace vendors next Wed. Maria to draft copy and partner FAQ by Apr 8. Priya shipping shim by Apr 15. Oliver to enable gateway fallback canary Apr 20. Lee to sign off on legal notice by Apr 10. Sam to provision telemetry dashboard by Apr 12.
Maria (product): draft copy posted here: http://go/redwood/drafts/sunset-v1-copy — includes partner-only preview section. please comment.
Priya (devex): repo: github.com/redwood/sdk-shims v1-to-v2 branch 'sunset-bridge'. Planned release flow: prerelease -> partner npm/pypi -> public. Migration snippet I'll include. Example snippet: `// shim example
if (req.get('Authorization') && req.get('Authorization').startsWith('Bearer-V1')) {
  const token = translateV1toV2(req.get('Authorization'))
  req.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`)
}`
Oliver (platform): note for ops: we'll add a 404->410 timeline in gateway when enforcement happens. ops runbook RNW-ops-238 created.
Nora (partnerships): SDK surface impacted: python-sdk <=2.3, js-sdk <=1.9. We'll include a migration guide and a compatibility matrix in the partner portal.
Sam (eng): I'll add tagging to logs and a daily report for any partners still using v1 so partnerships can outreach.
Maria (product): proposed comms timeline: Apr 8 partner preview, Apr 15 adapters + docs public preview, Apr 22 public docs and marketplace notice, May 6 enforcement.
Lee (legal): that schedule works from our side given a 3-week partner notice window for breaking changes per contracts.
Nora (partnerships): owners confirmed: partnerships=Maria, adapter=Priya, gateway=Oliver, eng-sig=Sam, legal=Lee. Everyone pls update RNW-4821 with owner + timeline and tag me.
Priya (devex): will post initial shim prerelease link when PR lands.
Oliver (platform): canary plan: enable in eu-west Apr 20, us-west Apr 27, then global May 4 before enforcement.
Nora (partnerships): thanks all. Partnerships will prep outreach doc and escalation matrix for top partners. :thumbsup:
Sam (eng): thumbs up.
Everyone: :thumbsup:
